title: Span, unsafe, interop — concept map
intro: Slice memory without extra strings, know when stackalloc is legal, keep unsafe and fixed in a small box, and treat Platform Invoke (P/Invoke) as a boundary — not a C++ course. Span and Memory reduce allocation traps from module 14; LibraryImport connects to source generators from module 16.

flowchart TD
  A[Parse or interop need] --> B{Size and lifetime}
  B -->|Small bounded| C[stackalloc plus Span]
  B -->|Heap field async| D[Memory T ArrayPool]
  B -->|Native DLL| E[LibraryImport PInvoke]
  E --> F[unsafe fixed only if needed]
  C --> G[Slice TryParse no Substring]

conceptCards.title: Span and Memory
conceptCards.summary: Span is stack-only view. Memory storable for async. Slice and TryParse without Substring allocations.

conceptCards.title: stackalloc CSV
conceptCards.summary: Stack buffer for bounded CSV lines. Span field walk. Stream with yield for huge files.

conceptCards.title: unsafe and fixed
conceptCards.summary: Pointers for interop. fixed pins during native call. Keep in small reviewed shim.

conceptCards.title: P/Invoke awareness
conceptCards.summary: LibraryImport over DllImport. SkiaSharp needs using. Marshaling and lifetime at boundary.

revisionDiagram.title: Span and interop revision map
revisionDiagram.source:
mindmap
  root((Span unsafe interop))
    Span Memory
      ref struct stack only
      Slice zero copy
      Memory for async fields
      TryParse on spans
    stackalloc CSV
      Bounded max line size
      Span walk not Split
      ArrayPool if large
      yield stream import
    unsafe fixed
      AllowUnsafeBlocks project
      Pin short fixed blocks
      Fragmentation if long pin
      Prefer Span when possible
    PInvoke
      LibraryImport generator
      String marshalling charset
      SkiaSharp using dispose
      Native outside GC heap
